name: portail-client-mobile
description: Application Android et iOS du Portail client (Capacitor).

scripts.android:init: npm run prepare-shell && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android && node scripts/android-version.mjs
scripts.ios:init: npm run prepare-shell && npx cap add ios && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios
scripts.sync: npm run prepare-shell && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
